name: bolivia-iva
description: Bolivia IVA (Impuesto al Valor Agregado, 13%) and IT (Impuesto a las Transacciones, 3%) for 2026 under Ley 843 Títulos I and VI and their regulations DS 21530 and DS 21532, as consolidated by the Servicio de Impuestos Nacionales (SIN) to 30 September 2026. Covers who pays, the 13% rate applied to the invoiced price with the tax inside it, debit and credit, the proportional credit, carried-forward balances updated by the UFV, exports and zero rates, imports, invoices and electronic invoicing, the monthly Forms 200 and 400 with their boxes, NIT-digit deadlines, the IT base and exemptions, the IUE credit against IT, IT and IUE withholdings when buying from individuals without an invoice, 2026 changes (DS 5563, Ley 1718) and penalties. Trigger on: Bolivia IVA, Bolivia VAT, Formulario 200, Formulario 400, debito fiscal, credito fiscal, factura Bolivia, Impuesto a las Transacciones, IT 3%, SIN filing, RCV.
